value.answer: Good news, there's a free option in Toronto. The Ontario Structured Psychotherapy Program gives adults free, publicly funded CBT for depression and anxiety. You don't need a health card and you can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp. It isn't for everyone and doesn't cover unstructured talk therapy, so if that's what you want, low-cost clinics are another route. The Centre for Training in Psychotherapy listed $45 a session with a supervised student, and Fika offers online therapy at $65 a session with a free 15-minute consult. Those prices come from older listings and may have changed, and I can't confirm any of these clinics is taking new clients right now.
